about: The player's attacks while locked on. Each one fires an Elden Ring behavior event picked from swing_map.

columns.kcd2_attack_type: combat_attack_type_name in KCD2 (stamina ratio read live)
columns.uses_zone: true = the star cursor picks the swing; false = one swing regardless of zone
columns.extra_stamina: Stamina drained on top of Elden Ring's own cost: (relative_stamina_cost - 1) * BaseAttackStaminaCost * stamina_scale
columns.stamina_scale: KCD2 stamina points -> Elden Ring stamina points
columns.buffer_s: Seconds an input is remembered while the previous swing is still playing
